component.name: Frigicom
component.summary: Logos chat client written in Rust

description.p: Frigicom is an open-source chat client for the Logos network, written in Rust with the Iced GUI library. It runs its own private logoscore daemon, so there are no servers to configure and nothing to log into.
It is a fork of Halloy, an IRC client by Casper Rogild Storm, Cory Forsstrom, and Andrew Baldwin, and keeps its chrome — panes, sidebar, themes, keyboard navigation.
